claude_proposed_widenings.name: activation_rider
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Instinctive Pounce fires 'as part of the Bonus Action you take to enter your Rage' — it has no independent activation cost, no use count, and no reset cadence. The current surface only models class features as independently activated units (ClassFeatureActivationMechanics), which requires activationCost + resource + resetCadence. A new family is needed for passive riders on existing feature activations.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: As part of the Bonus Action you take to enter your Rage, you can move up to half your Speed.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: move effect in ClassFeatureEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect 'move up to half your Speed' is a move effect. ClassFeatureEffect currently only covers grant_extra_action and heal_hp. A move variant (or fractional-speed move variant) is needed to express this mechanically.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can move up to half your Speed.
